meta.rule: District ids come from the CitySpec (frontend/app/cityos.js). This file only adds how each district works: its queue, budget, retry limit and which permissions it may run unattended. registry/districts.json is generated from both; never edit it by hand.
meta.queue: GitHub issues labeled district:<id>. An issue runs only with the label 'approved'. 'blocked' parks it with its question. Labels need repo write access, so only collaborators can approve.
